quotes.text: When you scale a mess, you don't get efficiency. You get a bigger faster mess. You get a system where errors propagate at the speed of the cloud.

quotes.text: But in reality, co-pilot accelerates creation while doing absolutely nothing to accelerate accountability or architecture. If you are using AI to build flows faster, on top of an unmanaged foundation, you aren't solving your debt problem.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

takeaways: Automating a broken process with Power Automate does not fix it; it scales the mess and compounds technical debt.
The technical debt ratio, the share of orphaned flows and remediation time versus build time are better health signals than run counts.
Eliminate and standardize before you automate, build modular child flows with owners, service accounts and deprecation dates, and do not expect AI to clean up later.
hook: Many organizations wrap broken, manual workflows in Power Automate flows and call it transformation, only to scale technical debt. This episode gives Power Platform leaders and makers a framework to measure automation debt with the technical debt ratio, gate what gets built and refactor critical flows in a two-week sprint.
